restrictions.reason: Break Encounter Loop is meaningful only while an encounter result script is running.
Eliminate Simple Encounter Option changes the currently running Simple Encounter.
Eliminate Complex Encounter Choice changes the currently running Complex Encounter.
End Battle requires an active combat runtime.
Revive NPC After Combat is documented for an NPC Monster Macro.
Alter NPC / Monster During Combat requires an active combat runtime.
De-animate Lower Undead is documented for Monster and Battle Macros only.
Cause Fumble is documented for Monster Macros only.
Cause Rout is documented for Monster and Battle Macros only.
Spawn Monster is documented for Monster and Battle Macros only.
Destroy Related Monsters is documented for Monster and Battle Macros only.
Battle Macro Criteria is evaluated by an assigned Battle Macro after combat rounds.
Continue If Monster Present is documented for Monster and Battle Macros only.
